verdict.rationale: Dropbox has no documented user-facing automation builder in the evidence. Background automation is only possible by writing your own code: webhooks report changes (dropbox-docs-4, dropbox-docs-28), and the Files API/SDKs can act on files in response (dropbox-docs-3, dropbox-docs-2). The only built-in automation is narrow: Dropbox Sign can automatically save signed documents to storage (dropbox-docs-16). Missing for 10: a native no-code or AI-driven automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous agents, documentation of background automation rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
